transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. I'd like to get started on our check-in for 'The Last Harbor.' Before we finalize the presentation package, I need to hear from each of you on the archive, music, and technical fronts. Who'd like to begin?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important on the archive front. I reviewed an archive-license amendment received yesterday, and it confirms that this festival screening must use the Northlight Archive's 35mm print, retain the film's 1.33:1 image framing without cropping, and display the exact credit 'Restored by Northlight Archive.' I haven't entered the amendment into the festival rights tracker yet, but this directly affects our draft package — the proposed digital projection and standard 16:9 screen mask would not comply.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue on the music and technical front. I tested the screening room with the live-score setup this morning, and the room's pit and monitoring arrangement supports only a solo piano — not the proposed string trio. Additionally, the commissioned score cleared for this performance is 'Tide Marks,' and I have not yet updated the technical run sheet to reflect any of this.
transcript.speaker: A3
